1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. Application is disposed of.

1. This petition has been filed for quashing for FIR No. 191/2021 registered at PS Sultan Puri, Delhi under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC on the ground that the parties have settled their disputes vide MOU dated 20th July, 2022 which is on record of this Court.

Petitioner No.1-3 and respondent No.
2 (complainant) are present in Court and are duly identified by their counsels and the Investigating Officer.

2. Petitioner No. 1 and respondent No. 2 were married on 08th February, 2019 but due to disputes and differences the marriage ended in divorce vide decree dated 02nd November, 2022 which is also on record of this Court.
No child was born out of wedlock.
3. As per settlement balance amount of Rs. 2 lacs is to be tendered vide DD No.160478 drawn on Bank State Bank of India to the respondent No. 2 who has duly received and acknowledged it.

4. Considering the above settlement between the parties and the chances of conviction of the petitioners being remote and bleak, there is no use continuing with proceedings of the present FIR as it would be a misuse of the process of the Court and an unnecessary burden on the State exchequer.
Accordingly, the petition is allowed.
